basic_info.description: Two, 2 bedroom flats plus a legal room & bathroom on the garage level which is ideal for a home office or recreation room. Top floor flat and lower room & bath are vacant and were fully remodeled with an open floor plan, quality appliances, luxury vinyl floors, insulation, on demand water heaters, and in unit laundry. Peek-a-boo view of the ocean from the living room. Open floorplan with lots of natural light. Side by side garages plus parking for 2 cars in the driveway. Cozy backyard. Great location 1 block from Golden Gate park and walking  distance to Ocean Beach and Judah Street. Lower area with a room & bath approx. 350 sq.ft.
